basic_info.description: One bedroom with parking. This amazing unit at the Arterra offers a perfect blend of style and convenience, showcasing city views centered around the iconic Salesforce Tower and offering a wealth of amenities. The open living and dining area has huge floor-to-ceiling windows, gleaming floors, and a separate bedroom level that provides exceptional privacy. The kitchen boasts an island/bar, new gas range, new microwave and ample cabinet space. The bedroom with new premium carpet, has a city-view window and a closet. Additional features include double-pane windows, new floor to ceiling roller shades, in-unit washer and dryer, and assigned garage parking conveniently located next to the side lobby entrance. Arterra, San Francisco's first LEED-Silver residential green high-rise, offers a sunny roof deck with BBQ, fitness center, community room, bike racks, private guest suite, parking garage, and 24/7 attended lobby. Situated in a vibrant neighborhood, youll enjoy instant access to Mission Park and Mission Creek for kayaking, basketball, tennis, volleyball, and scenic waterfront trails. Enjoy local cafes, award-winning restaurants, nightlife, and craft cocktail bars, with Caltrain, Muni, and freeway access all within a block. This condo is ready for you to move right in!
